INSERT INTO CLUB (CLUBNUM, CLUBNAME, CLUBINFO, REGDATE, STUDENTID) VALUES (#{clubNum}, #{clubName}, #{clubInfo}, SYSDATE, #{studentId})
mapper.update: UPDATE CLUB SET CLUBNAME = #{clubName}, CLUBINFO = #{clubInfo}, STUDENTID = #{studentId} WHERE CLUBNUM = #{clubNum}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.CLUBNUM, C.CLUBNAME, C.CLUBINFO, C.REGDATE, M.STUDENTID, M.MAJOR, M.NAME, M.EMAIL1, M.EMAIL2, M.PHONE FROM CLUB C JOIN MEMBER M ON C.STUDENTID = M.STUDENTID ORDER BY C.CLUBNUM DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
SELECT C.CLUBNUM, C.CLUBNAME, C.CLUBINFO, C.REGDATE, M.STUDENTID, M.MAJOR, M.NAME, M.EMAIL1, M.EMAIL2, M.PHONE FROM CLUB C JOIN MEMBER M ON C.STUDENTID = M.STUDENTID ORDER BY C.CLUBNUM DESC
